svg.desc: The KRYN wordmark with the tagline "A local coding agent workspace for Apple Silicon Macs", the stack "OpenCode, Qwen3.5-9B on oMLX, 96K context", and a terminal showing real output of kryn --version (KRYN 1.0.1) and an excerpt of kryn controls.
